summary: Add opt-in native archive-addressed envelope/signature export, raw repair-witness reads and bounded cold-peer replication differences; default readers remain unchanged

replay.detail: No graph replay or cold repair mutation is performed by these readers.

schema.detail: No database or archive-format schema change; callers explicitly supply already verified immutable version-one segments.

rules.detail: Existing authoritative retirement and payloadless checkpoint inventory semantics remain in force.

compatibility.detail: New inactive library APIs emit the existing replication envelope/exchange types without a new peer protocol. Existing daemon entrypoints remain hot-only. Conflicting duplicate evidence fails closed; mutable overlay activation remains gated.

manual.detail: No production operation or hot-row removal.

recovery.detail: Revert leaves the unchanged hot persistence and default readers intact. Retain previously created segments and their external seals.
